rules.footnote: Drawdown is measured on equity (balance + unrealised PnL). A breach closes all open positions at market and ends the account.

faq.a2: On equity, which is balance plus unrealised PnL. Daily drawdown is measured from your daily starting balance (reset at 00:00 UTC); max drawdown is measured from the initial account size.

platform.f2Body: Equity, free margin, margin level and drawdown headroom update with every tick.
